sprint: Add Something Gains "Photo" -- a Freestanding Story-Owned Image
task: Closes the remaining half of item #6's own literal wording, 'Under add category for images', alongside the already-shipped From This World grouping. From This World only ever offers a Theme Author's own availableToCreator-flagged Collection assets -- for a Story with no such assets, or a Story Author who just wants their own picture, Add Something had no way to insert a plain, standalone image; the only upload path anywhere was the per-Place Add Artwork flow, which fills the Scene's own dedicated Artwork Place, not a freestanding decoration. Confirmed via investigation that renderer/slideRenderer.js's existing kind:'image' sticker path (_drawStickerImage/_ensureDecorationImage) is already fully agnostic to where a .image reference came from, so this is purely a new authoring entry point onto an already-proven rendering path -- zero renderer changes needed. New _addImageObject() in js/contextPanel.js mirrors _addShapeObject/_addTextObject/_addDoodleObject's own established shape exactly: a hidden file input, FileReader, routed through the existing _storeUploadedAsset adapter (downscale-if-large, AssetStore.put for a durable vihu-asset: reference, raw data: URI fallback), landing on a real SceneEngine.addSticker({kind:'image',...}) call immediately selected via setSelectedSceneElement -- the identical Refine panel (Position/Size/Rotation/Opacity/Lock/Duplicate/Delete) a Collection-sourced picture already gets. _addSomethingItems() gained one new 'Photo' row inserted right after Doodle and right before the conditional From This World push, so the two image-sourcing options ('bring your own' vs 'browse what this World offers') sit adjacent. Verified via a new 17-assertion Playwright suite: a theme with no Collection entries shows Photo unconditionally with From This World absent, a real native-file-chooser upload (not a synthetic call) produces the correct sticker fields/thumbnail/Selection-Action-Strip-label/live-canvas-paint, a second upload confirms two distinct image stickers coexist, and delete only removes the targeted one; a theme with Collection entries shows both rows adjacent. Two real test-harness bugs found and fixed during verification (not app bugs): a too-narrow data:-only thumbnail assertion (a blob: URL is an equally real resolved thumbnail); and a crash on the suite's second Add Something open, traced to Context Panel's own established Personalize-collapses-to-a-re-openable-strip behaviour, fixed by having the test re-click .context-personalize-collapsed first. Full regression across 7 sibling scratch suites sharing js/contextPanel.js all pass unchanged. Both goldenBuild.js suites (World Builder v1 and v2) pass unchanged, confirming zero impact on either Builder-tooling surface. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Builder/Creator Governing Rules change; confined to js/contextPanel.js. This closes all six items of the governing six-item request stated at the top of this run of entries.
